title: Netflix is using an AI-generated Gene Wilder voice in its Willy Wonka reality show
brief: Netflix is using an AI-generated voice of Gene Wilder for its upcoming reality competition show "Wonka's The Golden Ticket," premiering September 23rd, produced in collaboration with AI audio company ElevenLabs and with approval from Wilder's family. This marks Netflix's continued use of synthetic voice technology across productions, following similar work recreating voices of Michael Caine and Stan Lee.
